content.text: Done. Summarize the change and verification.

## Change summary

**`src/service.ts` — `DocumentService.archive`** now enforces visibility and role-based authorization in order:

1. **Visibility gate** — looks up the document and throws `Error('not found')` if it's missing, `deleted`, or belongs to a different tenant. This applies to every actor including admins.
2. **Permission gate** (checked even on already-archived documents) — `admin` may archive any visible document; `editor` only when `document.owner === actor.user`; `viewer` (or any other role) never may. Unauthorized requests throw `Error('forbidden')`.
3. **Idempotent mutation** — only if permission passed and `!document.archived` does it call `repository.archive(document, actor.user)`, which sets `archived = true` and appends exactly `{actor: actor.user, document: id}` to `audit`. Repeating on an archived document is a no-op with no audit entry.

All checks happen before any mutation, so failures leave documents and audit untouched. The public interface (`archive(actor: Actor, id: string): void`) and all other files are unchanged.

**`checks/authorization.cjs`** (new) — covers the full matrix:
- admin archives any visible tenant document; editor archives only owned documents; viewer is always forbidden (even own/archived docs)
- missing, deleted, and foreign-tenant documents throw `'not found'` for all roles, including admin; deleted/foreign checks take precedence over role errors
- repeat archive is a no-op with no duplicate audit entry, while permission is still enforced first (editor non-owner archived → `'forbidden'`)
- failing calls leave a JSON snapshot of every document and audit entry unchanged; successful calls append exactly one `{actor, document}` entry in order

**Verification:** `tsc -p tsconfig.json && node checks/public.cjs && node checks/authorization.cjs` → public check silent/passing, `authorization checks passed`, `OK`.
